registration.truth: post-acquisition-object-blur effective continuum color temperature and signed template coefficient
registration.calibration_policy: perturb acquisition only; reconstruct with unchanged nominal checkpoint
registration.noise_pairing: same generator seed for three conditions within a replicate; Poisson draws depend on expectation
registration.coverage_policy: template error uses full image with invalid predictions filled by zero; temperature error is conditional on jointly valid pixels
registration.scope: synthetic single-template engineering scenarios; no independent measured spectra or hardware

notes: Temperature RMSE is conditional on jointly valid pixels; inspect coverage and saturation.
Null false-positive rates use signed coefficient >60 e; relative L2 keeps negative predictions.
Internal screens applied independently per family; stress failures do not change the checkpoint.
